lifecycles._note: SELF-SUFFICIENT depth variant of mysql-cluster-subops-guarded: provisions a dedicated mysql cluster (create bodies/wait/teardown copied VERBATIM from the live-proven database-mysql-cluster (run gha-chatheavy-28595785223, 2026-07-02)), runs the guarded sub-op steps against it, then deletes it. Exists because the guarded variant only soft-captures an EXISTING cluster (a live-cluster window) — dispatched alone it records reachability 4xx/5xx, never the real 2xx needed for promotion (observed run 28595785223). heavy:true + billable: ~40min cluster. Guarded variant kept unchanged for window-style runs. The replica/restore groups are EXCLUDED here — against a live cluster those creates can succeed with no capture/cleanup (untracked billable clusters); they belong to gen-heavy-*-replica/-restore.
